name: Hisn al-Muslim & Azkar API
description: Structured open-source API and CDN dataset for Hisn al-Muslim (Fortress of the Muslim) supplications and daily Azkar (Morning & Evening, Sleep, Prayer, Travel, Protection). Features Arabic text with full tashkeel, English & multilingual translations, transliterations, repetitions counter, and audio recitations.

endpoints.name: Complete Fortress of the Muslim (Arabic)
endpoints.description: Returns the complete database of 132+ chapters and hundreds of authentic supplications with Arabic vocalized text, repetition count, reference citations, and audio URLs.

endpoints.name: Hisn al-Muslim (English / Multilingual)
endpoints.description: Returns English translations and phonetic transliterations for all supplications.
